description: Deterministically resolve a folder and generate AI package resources — eBook, mind map and/or quiz — for every CONVERTED video, one request per video × resource (POST /aiworkflow ABSTRACT | MINDMAP | QUESTIONS, like the dashboard). Default: the three resources in each video's own language. Resources a video already has in a language (or is still generating) are skipped. PAID: 1 credit per minute of video per resource per language (minimum 1 min; a partial minute counts only past 1 s); on an active Gold/Enterprise plan the free daily AI quota covers the first requests while it lasts (1 use per request). dry_run=true (default) returns the cost preview; execution is refused when the balance doesn't cover the cost.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

from_lang.description: Spoken language of the videos. Default: each video's original language, else 'auto'

resources.description: Which resources to generate (default all three)

to_langs.description: Languages to generate in, e.g. ['pt-BR','en']. Default: each video's own language

name: panda_action_enable_ai_package_for_folder
title: Enable AI Package for Folder
